description: Has this published JSON Schema or OpenAPI document changed since a fingerprint you hold? The schema-drift recheck of the pre-spend policy: run it when a provider's published contract may have moved before you pay it again. Paid per call via x402; DSSE-signed receipt.

known_fingerprint.description: The fingerprint from a previous check. Empty means first observation.
known_fingerprint.title: Known Fingerprint

payment_signature.description: x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit it to receive the payment terms; call again with it to run the tool.

url.description: Public URL of a JSON Schema or OpenAPI document
url.title: Url

name: ghost_schema_freshness
